root_cause.path: document mouseover delegation around tooltip rendering
root_cause.observed: Each mouseover rebuilt tooltip HTML, scanned sibling dots, and called getComputedStyle; pointer movement within one dot could amplify event/render work.

evidence.patch: Changed tooltip delegation to pointerover/pointerout and added same-dot identity suppression before DOM rebuild.

remaining_unknowns: The exact contribution of synchronous Python API subprocess latency and WKWebView compositor behavior is not isolated by this static-only work order.
No live AX/Tauri/UI test was run because commander-state.json ui_safety_lock is ACTIVE.
